_comment: `lib/index.js` is a dynamic entry (main1 reads only `X` from it) whose facade is merged into the common chunk holding `x.js`. `y.js`, shared by main2 and main3, lands in its own common chunk that imports `X` from the host. The namespace object rebuilt in the host must hold only what the dynamic import reads: a getter for `Y` would make the host import the `y.js` chunk, closing a cycle that, entered through main1, runs `y.js` before `X` is initialized.
